cfg_comparison.candidate_vs_retail: not block-comparable. The candidate decomposes the per-record body into decode_chunk_record; the compared properties are the stage order, branch decisions, writes and return values listed below.

compared_properties: cdecl no-argument boundary; single retn at 0x005114F3; EAX is the entry g_b16ca4 value on every path
g_c31090 += g_b16ca4 before the early count<=0 return; records advance by 0x30 from 0x00B16CE0
record header reads: +0x18 level, +0x1C flags, +0x20 node pointer, +0x24 token, +0x28 neighbour token, +0x2C cache pointer
pool selection (A while count <= limit-3, then B, then C; no-room path stamps cache+0x10=0xFFFFFFFF and skips) and descriptor publication g_b12c60[g_b16c9c] then g_b16c9c++
material page (token&0xFFFF != 0xFFFF): 0x00BA80B0 + index*0x30, scales *1/256, origin doubles, page index +0x18
texture modifier (level>=0xE): 0x00BA2030 + index*0x30; shift = byte+3; neighbour records rebuilt only when the +0x28 token changes, four 0x18-byte entries

vertex decode: 6-bit fields at shifts 14/20/26 minus 0x18, axis/mirror permutation from flags bits 0/2, world = offset*scale/3.0 + record doubles, optional modifier height (height as fourth component when level<=0xE, added to z otherwise)
two streams: first_vertices entries of 4 floats and extra_vertices entries of 3 floats plus the packed low-6-bit material slot; chunk header +0x18=(first<<16)|total and +0x1C=level

material bit loop builds the per-material descriptor indices; trailer/promotion re-derives the chunk size, promotes to pool B while <0xC80 and to pool C while <0x1F40, copies the old chunk, rewrites cache +0x18/+0x14 and g_b12c5c, and releases the old slot
divergences: The candidate is a 7-block driver plus a 251-block decode_chunk_record helper; retail is one 143-block function. Block-for-block equivalence is not claimed.
Runtime-populated tables (0x00BA2030, 0x00BA5050, 0x00BA80B0, 0x00C28FE4, 0x00C30080) and pool limits/base/stride are unresolved; the candidate uses zero-initialised storage.
The 0x24-byte per-vertex metadata is a zero-initialised heap vector instead of the retail fixed stack area; the material-descriptor loop is bounded to 32 entries.
x87 80-bit intermediates are modelled with float/double and FISTP as truncation; exact floating-point semantics are not modelled.
